span.p:
提示 Existing plate:
讀取目標原車牌

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
調用 ReadRecord() 讀取:
Plate, Category, Color, Entry time

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
調用 service.DeleteVehicle(Role::kAdmin, plate)
校驗非空/無空格並從 std::map 移除

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
調用 Validated(record, reference):
1. NormalizeField() 禁控制字符/去首尾空格/禁車牌空格
2. ParseTimestamp() 校驗 YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM 與閏年
3. NormalizeToMinute() 攔截未來時間 (entry > ref)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
輸出對應錯誤提示:
Invalid required field. / Invalid entry time. /
Entry time is in the future.
(原內存數據保持不變)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
檢查 std::map 車牌存在性與唯一性:
- add: 目標車牌是否已存在?
- modify: 原車牌是否存在? 新車牌是否與他車衝突?
